html:
Unique Research · Insight / Earnings · April 30, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

HKEX:01948 FY2021 (filed Mar 31’22; listed Nov 8’21 with ByteDance, Xiaomi, Gaorong backing): rev ¥7.841B (+23.3% vs ¥6.361B), NI ¥254M (+91.0%; 4yr NI CAGR 71.9%), adjusted NI ¥271M (+98.7%). Two lines: all-in-one online marketing solutions (plan/produce/buy/optimize ads across major platforms) and ad distribution (traffic acquisition for client-specified media). Short-video marketing solutions vendor that outperformed a choppy 2021 category. Charts in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
